title: Norm Plugin And Per-Family Apps
description: Add retained headless NormHost session layer on top of existing family crates, then ship one WASM DocumentApp per family (13 apps) in norm/plugin so compliance can run without UI while the plugin mirrors host state.
summary: Added headless NormHost session layer in norm_core (NormFamily trait, SetDocumentOp, NormHost) and wired Document/Op/evaluate/Host into all 13 family crates. Created norm-plugin WASM crate with one DocumentApp per family (13 apps, ports 6091–6103), playground metadata, workspace registration, launch.json test target extension, and passing plugin tests including host-backed report and undo/redo round-trip.
